description: A jazz trio plays on a lit wooden stage under a canopy at dusk, with a trumpeter in a dark suit at center, a pianist at left, and an upright bassist and drummer at right. A seated audience in deck chairs and on a blanket faces the stage on a grass lawn, with sailboats on the water to the left and a large shingle-style house with a porch behind. The palette is dark blue and warm lamplight, the dress looks mid-20th century, and I see no visible text, frame, or gore.
